entities.summary: Count Sergey Dmitrievich Sheremetev was a Russian public figure, historian, collector. A rich landowner, he owned the Kuskovo, Mikhailovskoye, Vvedenskoye and Ostafyevo estates in Moscow Governorate and the Fountain House Saint Petersburg Oberjägermeister since 1904, he held the Active State Councillor rank. The Sheremetyevskaya railway station was named after him, after which in turn the Sheremetyevo Airport was later named.
